title: Rule-setting, operation and assurance named

statement.en: The rulebook shall name which body performs rule-setting, which operates, and which assures, and shall disclose overlaps. Separation of these functions is a direction and maturity target, not a core rule.

control: The responsibility matrix names a body per function and discloses overlaps
source: DSSC decision log O-04, D-25 (to be merged with M1.separation.01)
